verses.text: For the music director, with stringed instruments. A psalm for reflection by David. Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide from my plea.
Pay attention and answer me. I’m restless in my distress, and I groan
because of my enemy’s threats and the pressure of the wicked. They bring suffering on me and hold on to their anger against me.
My heart aches inside me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
Fear and trembling have seized me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
I said, “If only I had wings like a dove! I’d fly away and find rest.
I’d go far away and stay out in the wilderness.” Selah.
“I’d hurry to find shelter from the howling wind and the storm.”
Lord, confuse them and scramble their words, because I’ve seen violence and conflict in the city.
Day and night they prowl along its walls. Malice and abuse fill the city.
Ruin is at work inside it. Threats and lies never leave its streets.
If an enemy had insulted me, I could have borne it. If someone who hated me had risen against me, I could have hidden from them.
But it was you, someone like me, my companion and close friend.
We enjoyed each other’s company and walked with the crowd into God’s house.
Let death catch them by surprise. Let them go down alive to Sheol, because wickedness lives in their homes and among them.
As for me, I’ll call on God, and the LORD will save me.
Evening, morning, and noon I cry out in distress, and he hears my voice.
He brought me safely out of the battle against me, even though many stood against me.
God, who has been on his throne forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They refuse to change and have no fear of God.
My companion turned against his friends and broke his covenant.
His speech was smooth as butter, but his heart was set on war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
Give your burden to the LORD, and he’ll sustain you. He’ll never let the righteous be shaken.
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Violent and deceitful people won’t live out half their days. I’ll put my trust in you.
